summary: send the latest data of each remote object at most once per window
use_when: one object changes many times a second but the remote allows one edit per window
a rate-limit answer must hold a sender's edits back
not_for: queues that must deliver every message: the latest data of an object wins and the earlier ones are dropped
the remote call itself or the meaning of its errors: the host binds the Editor and Reader ports
retrying failed edits for long: only a rate limit is retried, once
